script:
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/security_analyzer" --json '{}' \
  --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc contains security_analyzer --save F08.analyzer-errors/missing
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/security_analyzer" --json '{"security_analyzer": {"kind": "NopeAnalyzer"}}' \
  --expect 422 --check detail.0.msg contains 'Unknown kind'
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOPE/security_analyzer" --json '{"security_analyzer": null}' --expect 404
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/security_analyzer" --json '{"security_analyzer": {"kind": "PatternSecurityAnalyzer"}}' \
  --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID" --check security_analyzer eq null
